title: The Canary in the Coal Decline: Appalachian Household Finance and the Transition from Fossil Fuels
abstract: The energy transition away from fossil fuels, despite its substantial overall climate benefits, presents significant transition risks for communities historically built around the fossil fuel industry. This paper uses the decline in the Appalachian coal industry between 2011 and 2018 to understand how individuals are harmed by a reduction in local fossil fuel extraction activity. We use individual-level credit data and exogenous variation in coal demand from the electricity sector to identify how the coal mining industry’s decline affected the finances of Appalachian households. We find that the decline in demand for coal caused broad-based negative impacts, decreasing credit scores and increasing credit utilization, delinquencies, amounts in third party collections, bankruptcy rates, and the number of individuals with subprime status. These effects were broad based and cannot be explained solely by individuals who lost coal mining jobs. Individuals with the lowest pre-period credit scores were more likely to end up in financial distress and experienced a greater deterioration in credit scores. Quantile regressions show that the drop in credit scores from the coal decline was most pronounced between the 30th and 50th percentiles of the credit score distribution. Our results provide evidence that people living in fossil fuel extraction regions are likely to experience declines in financial well-being from the energy transition even if they do not directly work in the affected industry.
abstract_zh: 尽管能源从化石燃料转向清洁能源总体上具有巨大的气候效益，但对于那些历史上围绕化石燃料产业建立起来的社区而言，它也带来了重大的转型风险。本文利用2011至2018年间阿巴拉契亚煤炭产业的衰退，来理解化石燃料本地开采活动的减少如何伤害个人。我们使用个人层面的信贷数据，并利用电力部门煤炭需求的外生变动，识别煤矿业的衰退如何影响阿巴拉契亚家庭的财务状况。我们发现，煤炭需求的下降造成了广泛的负面影响，表现为信用评分下降、信贷使用率上升、逾期、第三方催收金额增加、破产率上升，以及次级信用状态人数增加。这些影响具有广泛性，无法仅由失去煤矿工作的个人来解释。信用评分最低的个人更有可能陷入财务困境，并经历了更大幅度的信用评分恶化。分位数回归表明，煤炭衰退导致的信用评分下降在信用评分分布的第30至第50百分位之间最为明显。我们的结果表明，生活在化石燃料开采地区的人们，即使不直接在受影响的行业工作，也很可能因能源转型而经历财务状况的恶化。

title: Flooding the Market? A Method for Examining Housing Market Outcomes After Discrete Shocks
In Hot Water? The Macroeconomic Impacts of El Niño
abstract: Despite their potentially major impacts, little is known about how El Niño impact the U.S. economy. El Niños are distinct from other commonly studied weather shocks because they are a global phenomenon, unfold over a period of months, can be forecast months in advance, are relatively infrequent, and have very different effects on weather outcomes depending on the time of year and region. These features make traditional analytical methods ill-suited to studying the economic impacts of El Niño events. In this paper I use a new approach to estimating the impulse response functions of El Niños. I find that El Niños pose material upside risk for PCE prices and employment. The longer-run price effects are driven by core services and food prices and depend on whether La Niñas follow El Niños, a very common occurrence. After modest offsetting initial effects, employment increases are widespread in terms of both sectors and states in the year following the El Niño. These results indicate El Niños can have material impacts on the US economy even though it is neither tropical nor agriculturally focused.
abstract_zh: 尽管厄尔尼诺现象可能产生重大影响，但人们对其如何影响美国经济知之甚少。厄尔尼诺与其他常被研究的天气冲击不同：它是全球性现象，持续数月发展，可以提前数月预报，发生频率相对较低，并且根据时间和地区的不同，对天气结果的影响也大相径庭。这些特征使得传统分析方法不适用于研究厄尔尼诺事件的经济影响。本文采用一种新方法来估计厄尔尼诺的脉冲响应函数。我发现，厄尔尼诺会给个人消费支出（PCE）价格和就业带来实质性的上行风险。较长期的价格效应由核心服务和食品价格驱动，并取决于厄尔尼诺之后是否紧随拉尼娜（这是非常常见的情形）。在经历了适度的、相互抵消的初始效应之后，就业增长在厄尔尼诺之后的一年内在各部门和各州都普遍出现。这些结果表明，厄尔尼诺即使既非热带性质也非以农业为主，仍可能对美国经济产生实质性影响。

title: Pricing Poseidon: Extreme Weather Uncertainty and Firm Return Dynamics
abstract: We empirically analyze firm-level uncertainty generated from extreme weather events, guided by a theoretical framework. Stock options of firms with establishments in a hurricane's (forecast) landfall region exhibit large implied volatility increases, reflecting significant uncertainty (before) after impact. Volatility risk premium dynamics reveal that investors underestimate such uncertainty. This underreaction diminishes for hurricanes after Sandy, a salient event that struck the U.S. financial center.  Despite constituting idiosyncratic shocks, hurricanes affect hit firms' expected stock returns. Textual analysis of calls between firm management, analysts, and investors reveals that discussions about hurricane impacts remain elevated throughout the long-lasting high-uncertainty period after landfall.
abstract_zh: 我们基于一个理论框架，对极端天气事件所产生的企业层面不确定性进行了实证分析。在飓风（预报）登陆区域内设有机构的企业，其股票期权的隐含波动率在飓风登陆前后出现大幅上升，反映出显著的不确定性。波动率风险溢价的动态表明，投资者低估了这种不确定性。这种反应不足在桑迪飓风之后有所减弱，桑迪是一场严重袭击美国金融中心的显著事件。尽管飓风属于特质性冲击，但它们仍会影响受灾企业的预期股票收益。对企业管理层、分析师与投资者之间电话会议的文本分析显示，在登陆后持续较长时间的高不确定性时期，关于飓风影响的讨论始终保持在较高水平。

title: The Local Economic Impact of Natural Disasters
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: We use nearly four decades of US county data to study dynamic local economic impacts of natural disasters that trigger federal aid. We find that these disasters on average raise personal income per capita in the longer run (eight years out). We also find that, in the longer run, wages and home prices are higher, while employment and population are unaffected, suggesting that the income boost may reflect productivity increases and greater demand for housing in supply-constrained areas or compositional shifts. Allowing for heterogeneity across disaster types, we find that the longer-run income boost is driven primarily by hurricanes and tornadoes. We also find that the longer-run boost increases with damages, suggestive of an important role for insurance and government aid—which are highly correlated with damages—in fueling recovery.
abstract_zh: 我们利用近四十年的美国县级数据，研究触发联邦援助的自然灾害对地方经济的动态影响。我们发现，这些灾害平均而言会在较长期（八年后）提高人均个人收入。我们还发现，从长期来看，工资和房价更高，而就业和人口不受影响，这表明收入的提高可能反映了生产率的提升以及在供给受限地区对住房需求的增加或人口构成的变化。在考虑灾害类型的异质性后，我们发现，较长期的收入提升主要由飓风和龙卷风驱动。我们还发现，较长期的提升随损失额的增加而增大，这暗示保险和政府援助（二者都与损失高度相关）在推动复苏中发挥了重要作用。

title: Sellin' in the Rain: Weather, Climate, and Retail Sales
abstract:
I apply a novel machine-learning based “weather index” method to daily store-level sales data for a national apparel and sporting goods brand to examine short-run responses to weather and long-run adaptation to climate. I find that even when considering potentially offsetting shifts of sales between outdoor and indoor stores, to the firm’s website, or over time, weather has significant persistent effects on sales. This suggests that weather may increase sales volatility as more severe weather shocks become more frequent under climate change. Consistent with adaptation to climate, I find that sensitivity of sales to weather decreases with historical experience for precipitation, snow, and cold weather events, but—surprisingly—not for extreme heat events. This suggests that adaptation may moderate some but not all the adverse impacts of climate change on sales. Retailers can respond by adjusting their staffing, inventory, promotion events, compensation, and financial reporting.
This paper was accepted by Rajesh Chandy, Special Section of Management Science on Business and Climate Change.
Funding: This work was supported by the National Science Foundation [Grant 0903551].
Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4799 .
abstract_zh:
我将一种新颖的、基于机器学习的“天气指数”方法应用于一家全国性服装和体育用品品牌的每日门店销售数据，以考察其对天气的短期反应和对气候的长期适应。我发现，即便考虑到门店之间（户外与室内门店）、向企业官网的销售转移，或随时间推移可能产生的相互抵消的变动，天气仍对销售具有显著且持续的影响。这表明，随着气候变化导致更严重的天气冲击变得更加频繁，天气可能会加剧销售波动。与气候适应的观点相一致，我发现，对于降水、降雪和寒冷天气事件，销售对天气的敏感性会随历史经验的积累而下降，但令人惊讶的是，对于极端高温事件则并非如此。这表明，适应可能会缓和气候变化对销售的部分但并非全部不利影响。零售商可以通过调整人员配置、库存、促销活动、薪酬以及财务报告来作出应对。
本文由Rajesh Chandy接收，发表于《管理科学》（Management Science）“商业与气候变化”专题。
资助：本研究得到美国国家科学基金会的支持［资助编号0903551］。
补充材料：数据文件和在线附录可访问 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4799 。

title: Divest, Disregard, or Double Down? Philanthropic Investments in Objectionable Firms
Discounting Behavior and Environmental Decisions
venue: Journal of Neuroscience, Psychology, and Economics
abstract: Discounting plays a major role in the life cycle of environmental and natural resource policies. Evaluating centuries-scale problems like climate change with standard dis-count rates yields results that many find ethically unacceptable. Paradoxes abound. Low discount rates are urged for determining the net benefits of climate change, while households fail to undertake energy conservation actions that have payback periods of only a few years. Efforts to uncover discount rates from revealed and stated preferences suggest that a variety of confounding factors may be simultaneously in play. Common property resources provide an example of how market failures can lead to behavior consistent with extreme discounting that can be addressed through effective policy. Finally, politicians who make ultimate policy decisions may have incentives to act in accordance with discount rates not socially optimal.
abstract_zh: 贴现在环境与自然资源政策的生命周期中扮演着重要角色。若用标准贴现率来评估气候变化这类以世纪为尺度的问题，所得结果在许多人看来是伦理上不可接受的。各种悖论层出不穷。在确定气候变化的净收益时，人们主张采用较低的贴现率，然而家庭却未能采取那些仅需几年即可收回成本的节能行动。从显示性偏好和陈述性偏好中揭示贴现率的努力表明，可能有多种混杂因素同时发挥作用。公共资源提供了一个例子，说明市场失灵如何导致与极端贴现相一致的行为，而这种行为可以通过有效的政策加以解决。最后，最终作出政策决定的政治家，可能有动机依据并非社会最优的贴现率行事。
